mapper.select: SELECT id, agency_id, login_id, password_hash, role, failed_login_count, is_locked, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM platform_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_user SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE platform_user SET is_locked = #{isLocked}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE platform_user SET failed_login_count = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
